definitions.explanation: The temperature of the surrounding environment, typically around 15-25°C. Frequently used on food labels and in cooking instructions to indicate that something should not be refrigerated.

examples.japanese: ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{常温|じょうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: Bring the butter to room temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常温|じょうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please store this medicine at room temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{常温|じょうおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ままだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The canned beer was still at room temperature, so I put it in the fridge.

notes:
Very commonly seen on food packaging and product labels. Japanese food labels often specify {常温|じょうおん}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (store at room temperature) versus {要冷蔵|ようれいぞう} (requires refrigeration).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常温|じょうおん}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (room-temperature storage)
- {常温|じょうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to bring to room temperature)
- {常温|じょうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧ (to store at room temperature)
- {常温|じょうおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (room-temperature water)
